description: code-first — inject the code-first contract when the session opted in with /idea or the prompt asks for a proposal (CODE_FIRST_TRIGGER_PATTERN; CODE_FIRST_INJECT=always for every prompt; per-repo override: CODE_FIRST_CONTRACT_FILE → .agent/code-first.md → .claude/code-first.md), in such a turn block a final message carrying more inline code than CODE_FIRST_MAX_FENCE_LINES (Stop), and show the user a one-line note naming stale idea branches (Stop). Kill-switches: CODE_FIRST_OFF=1 (all), CODE_FIRST_GUARD_OFF=1 (Stop guard only).

hooks.command: python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/inject.py" || echo '⚠️ code-first DISARMED — hook failed to execute.'
